svg.title: What the hooks do during a Claude Code session
svg.desc: A workflow diagram generated by Archify.

g.title: SessionStart · matcher: startup · Claude Code › session-start

g.aria-label: Focus Protocol + context, in the system prompt, Claude Code › session-start
g.title: Protocol + context · in the system prompt · Claude Code › session-start

g.aria-label: Focus search → work → save, mem_search · mem_finalize_session, Claude Code › working
g.title: search → work → save · mem_search · mem_finalize_session · Claude Code › working

g.aria-label: Focus Stop, session ends, Claude Code › session-stop
g.title: Stop · session ends · Claude Code › session-stop

g.aria-label: Focus syncSkills, pull → .claude/skills/, drymem hook (exit 0 always) › session-start
g.title: syncSkills · pull → .claude/skills/ · drymem hook (exit 0 always) › session-start

g.aria-label: Focus injectContext, GET /memories/context · team first, drymem hook (exit 0 always) › session-start
g.title: injectContext · GET /memories/context · team first · drymem hook (exit 0 always) › session-start

g.aria-label: Focus post-compaction, reload context, drymem hook (exit 0 always) › working
g.title: post-compaction · reload context · drymem hook (exit 0 always) › working

g.aria-label: Focus did the agent save?, reads the transcript, drymem hook (exit 0 always) › session-stop
g.title: did the agent save? · reads the transcript · drymem hook (exit 0 always) › session-stop

g.aria-label: Focus API, bearer token · per machine, drymem server › session-start
g.title: API · bearer token · per machine · drymem server › session-start
